description: Cancel an unaccepted placement assignment. Send only expectedVersion; the API determines the cancellation result. After acceptance the server returns STAFF_REQUIRED; participants cannot refund or partially settle accepted work. Requires confirm:true and a stable idempotencyKey.

confirm.description: Required confirmation: call only after the human explicitly approved this action.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable UUID for this command. Reuse the same UUID if its outcome is unknown.

name: vibevo_cancel_placement_assignment
title: Cancel an unaccepted placement assignment
